description: Optional 20-second hostile test. You: Shivam. Them: a friend playing an annoyed prospect.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi, this is Shivam from Brightline, calling about missed appointments at your clinic.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: How did you get this number? I'm not interested. Stop calling me.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Understood, sorry for the interruption. Could I send one email instead?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: No. Take me off your list.
